comment: Meshy AI generation manifest for THALASSA. Prompts are derived from docs/ENEMY-ROSTER.md. Models are ordered by priority: the most complicated, most distinctive silhouettes (bosses, hero, elites, floaters) are generated via Text-to-3D; common real-world beasts are 'library' models — search the Meshy community database (meshy.ai/discover) with library_query, download the GLB, and run `pipeline.py import`. Every generated prompt gets style_prefix prepended and texture_style appended to the texture prompt so the whole set keeps the game's flat-shaded board-game-miniature look.
style_prefix: Low-poly stylized fantasy game creature, flat-shaded faceted geometry, chunky bold silhouette like a hand-painted board game miniature, matte solid colors, minimal surface detail, ancient Greek myth adventure game art style.
texture_style: Hand-painted matte flat colors, high saturation solid color blocks, no metallic sheen, no photorealism, board game miniature style.

models.name: The Dark Lord
models.prompt: Colossal armored demon lord, final boss. Near-black iron full plate armor, tall dark-iron crown with glowing ember tips, great curved horns, spiked pauldrons, a row of spines down the back, clawed gauntlets, glowing red eyes. Massive heavy biped standing upright, arms at its sides, legs apart, towering and menacing.
models.texture_prompt: Near-black weathered iron armor, ember-orange glow on the crown tips, deep red glowing eyes, dark horn and claw accents.
models.notes: Largest model in the game (~2x other bosses). Rig degrades to body-level animation; no named armL/legL parts from Meshy.

models.name: The Boreal Wyrm
models.prompt: Giant ice sea-dragon boss rearing up out of the water in an S-curve. Long coiling serpent body of large faceted glacier scales, horned draconic head held high, open fanged maw, swept side fins, a ridge of jagged ice spikes down the whole spine, body tapering to a curled tail at the base.
models.texture_prompt: Deep glacier-blue scales, frost-white belly, translucent white ice spikes, pale cyan glowing eyes.
models.notes: Serpent rig (tail0..tail6) degrades to body sway; rear-up pose should be baked into the mesh.

models.name: The Strangler Matriarch
models.prompt: Monstrous carnivorous plant queen boss. Bulbous rounded body of dark wet bark and moss, one huge gaping vertical maw ringed with thorn teeth, six thick writhing vines reaching outward and upward from her shoulders like a crown, topped by one giant lurid open flower bloom with a glowing center. Rooted wide base instead of legs.
models.texture_prompt: Dark wet bark, deep jungle-green moss, magenta-pink flower petals, sickly green glowing eyes, blood-red inner maw.
models.notes: vine0..vine5 writhe animation degrades; bake vines in an expressive reaching pose.

models.name: The Dune Colossus
models.prompt: Giant desert titan boss built from stacked sandstone masonry blocks, like ancient ruined architecture come alive. Big blocky cube torso, heavy rectangular slab arms ending in huge stone fists, thick slab legs, a squared head with deep-set glowing eyes, and a burning molten core glowing inside an opening in the chest.
models.texture_prompt: Sun-bleached sandstone tan, darker weathered stone edges and cracks, molten amber glow from the chest core and eyes.
models.notes: Blocky architectural forms suit low-poly output well; core emissive is baked into texture.

models.name: The Stag King
models.prompt: Towering elk lord boss, a massive regal stag standing tall on long legs with a proud raised head. Enormous branching antlers with many tines, twice the size of a normal stag's antlers, dominating the silhouette. Thick fur coat, a small ornate gold crown nestled between the antlers.
models.texture_prompt: Deep amber and chestnut fur, bronze accents, bone-white antlers, pale glowing eyes, gold crown.
models.notes: Antlers are the signature — huge and readable at distance.

models.name: The Warden of the Pharos
models.prompt: Colossal pale marble hoplite sentinel, an ancient Greek warrior statue come alive. Plumed bronze Corinthian helmet with a gold crown ring, a long spear held upright in one hand, a large round shield on the other arm, draped stone tunic, a glowing core set in the chest. Standing guard, imposing and solemn.
models.texture_prompt: Pale weathered marble skin, aged bronze helmet and shield, crimson helmet plume, glowing cyan chest core, gold crown.
models.notes: Currently an unused asset in-game; generate last among bosses or skip with --models.

models.name: The Captain (player hero)
models.prompt: Ancient Greek hoplite warrior hero. Bronze plumed Corinthian helmet, a round bronze shield strapped on the left arm, a short spear held in the right hand, a short plain tunic in neutral mid-grey, leather sandals, tanned skin. Standing upright in a sturdy heroic pose.
models.texture_prompt: Polished bronze helmet and shield, crimson plume, plain neutral mid-grey tunic with no pattern, tanned skin, brown leather straps.
models.notes: IMPORTANT: game tints a material named 'PlayerTint' (falls back to 'cloth'). After import, rename the tunic material to PlayerTint in Blender, or accept an untinted captain.

models.name: Wickerwood Shambler
models.prompt: Hulking four-legged forest beast made of tangled dry wood and woven wicker branches. Bulky twisted-branch body, a shaggy mane of twigs around the neck, curved wooden horns, a blunt snarling head with glowing eyes, thick gnarled legs. Heavy lumbering stance.
models.texture_prompt: Dry brown dead wood and wicker, dark bark shadows, green moss accents in the crevices, glowing amber eyes.

models.name: Glacier Golem / Tomb Sentinel / Emerald Watch
models.prompt: Blocky stone golem construct, humanoid. Big cube torso, heavy rectangular slab arms and legs, a small squared head with deep-set glowing eyes, a glowing round core recessed in the center of the chest, cracked rocky surfaces. Standing heavy and square.
models.texture_prompt: Cold glacier ice and blue-grey stone, frost in the cracks, glowing cyan chest core and eyes.

variants.tomb: Sun-bleached tomb sandstone, darker weathered cracks, glowing amber chest core and eyes.
variants.emerald: Mossy jade-green stone, dark green creepers in the cracks, glowing green chest core and eyes.

models.name: Rime Harpy / Storm Harpy
models.prompt: Harpy monster, a winged woman-bird. Humanlike female head with wild windswept hair, a compact feathered bird body, two large spread wings, sharp taloned bird legs, a fanned tail of feathers. Perched upright with wings partly open, menacing.
models.texture_prompt: Dusky grey-brown feathers, pale skin, frost pale-blue rime accents on the wing tips and hair, small glowing eyes.
models.notes: wingL/wingR flap degrades to body animation; open-wing pose keeps her readable.

models.name: Ice Wraith / Mirage Dancer / The Pale Court
models.prompt: Hooded ghost phantom, hovering with no legs. A tattered hooded robe trailing down to a single wispy point above the ground, ragged torn hem pieces, ghostly draped sleeve arms held slightly out, and a dark empty void inside the hood with two small glowing eyes.
models.texture_prompt: Cold grey-blue tattered robe, darker inner hood void, cyan glowing eyes, faint frost highlights on the hem.

variants.mirage: Shimmering heat-pale sand-white robe, darker inner hood void, warm white glowing eyes.

models.notes: Floater: build hovers above ground; grounding offset is skipped for floaters (game rests them above ground).

models.name: Horned Shade / The Bleached Choir
models.prompt: Sinister horned dark priest phantom, hovering with no legs. A near-black hooded robe rising to a tall pointed mitre-like hood with two curved horns, robe trailing down to a single wispy point, ragged hem, draped sleeve arms, a dark void face with two glowing eyes. Priestly, ominous silhouette.
models.texture_prompt: Near-black robe with deep violet trim, dark horns, purple glowing eyes, faint purple ember accents on the hem.

models.name: Sirens' Kin
models.prompt: Sea spirit phantom, hovering with no legs. A flowing robed feminine figure with a watery translucent look, robe streaming down to a single wispy point like a wave, long flowing hair merging into the robe, serene luring posture with one draped arm extended, softly glowing face.
models.texture_prompt: Teal and sea-green flowing robe, aqua glowing face and accents, foam-white highlights along the flowing edges.

models.name: Briar Beast / Vine Horror
models.prompt: Plant monster made of a tangled knot of dark bark and thorny brambles. A rounded bramble-ball body with a wide gaping maw full of thorn teeth, two glowing eyes above the maw, and three thick vines reaching out from the body like limbs. Sits low on a rooted base.
models.texture_prompt: Dark bark and bramble browns, deep green moss and small leaves, red inner maw, amber glowing eyes.

models.name: Floe Stalker
models.prompt: Gaunt elongated ice predator, a four-legged stalking beast. Long thin legs, a stretched narrow body held low in a prowling stance, a narrow eyeless-looking head with small glowing eyes, a row of jagged translucent ice spikes down the spine, a long thin tail.
models.texture_prompt: Pale ice-blue hide, translucent white ice spikes, faint frost sheen, eerie cyan glowing eyes.

models.name: Drowned Sailor
models.prompt: Waterlogged undead sailor zombie. Pallid grey-green bloated skin, dark seaweed and kelp draped over the shoulders and torso, ragged rotted sailor clothes, a rusted cutlass sword held in one hand, hollow glowing eyes, slumped shambling stance.
models.texture_prompt: Drowned grey-green skin, dark kelp and seaweed, rusted brown-orange blade, ragged faded cloth, pale glowing eyes.

models.name: Cyclops Herdsman
models.prompt: Cyclops brute, a huge one-eyed giant. One single large glowing eye centered in the face, a heavy brow, slab shoulders, a bulky round torso, thick arms and legs, a crude animal-hide loincloth, and a heavy knotted wooden club held in one hand.
models.texture_prompt: Ruddy weathered giant skin, brown animal hide, dark knotted wood club, one big amber glowing eye.

models.name: Glass Scorpion / Dune Scourge
models.prompt: Giant desert scorpion made of pale translucent glass. Flat wide faceted body, four walking legs per side, two big raised pincer claws in front, and a segmented tail arcing forward over the back ending in a sharp stinger. Crystalline, faceted, glassy look.
models.texture_prompt: Pale desert-glass tan, translucent crystal facets with lighter edges, amber glowing eyes and stinger tip.
models.notes: Tail-over-back arc pose baked in; tail0..tail3+stinger sway degrades.

models.name: River Drake / Canopy Tyrant
models.prompt: Small wingless dragon walking on four legs. Horned reptile head with a fanged open jaw and no ears, a sturdy lizard body low to the ground, a row of spikes down the back, thick tapering reptilian tail, clawed feet.
models.texture_prompt: Jade and emerald green scales, sandy tan back spikes and belly, amber glowing eyes.

models.name: Thistle Faun
models.prompt: Satyr faun, a goat-legged humanoid. Curved goat horns, a mischievous grinning face, a lean bare torso, shaggy goat fur on the lower legs with hooves, holding a simple wooden spear in one hand. Light springy stance.
models.texture_prompt: Forest browns and greens, tan skin, dark shaggy goat fur, bone horns, plain wood spear.

models.name: Sand Raider / Satyr Brigand / Laestrygonian
models.prompt: Wiry humanoid desert marauder. Sun-worn leather and cloth garb with a head wrap, a curved bronze sword held in one hand, a small round shield strapped on the other arm, glowing eyes under the wrap, menacing half-crouched stance.
models.texture_prompt: Sun-worn tan and dusty red cloth, brown leather, aged bronze blade and shield boss, amber glowing eyes.

models.name: Brigand Skiff
models.prompt: Small hostile raider boat, not a creature. A ragged little dinghy of dark weathered wood planks, a single mast with a torn dirty triangular sail, a pair of oars resting in the rowlocks, and a menacing glowing lantern hung at the prow. Sits on a flat waterline base.
models.texture_prompt: Dark weathered wood planks, dirty off-white torn sail, rusted fittings, warm amber glowing lantern.
models.notes: Boat: bobbing is applied by the game; keep the hull base flat.

models.name: Leafshade / Frost / Sea Wolf, Frostfang Alpha
models.prompt: Lean predatory wolf standing alert on four legs. Pointed ears, a long snout with a slightly open jaw showing teeth, a shaggy ruff of fur around the neck, a brush tail, glowing eyes.
models.texture_prompt: Grey layered fur, darker back and mane, pale underside, amber glowing eyes.

variants.frost: Snow-white and pale ice-blue fur, frosted mane, cyan glowing eyes.

models.notes: Reused at grunt and larger alpha scale.

models.name: Snow Fox
models.prompt: Small dainty fox on four slender legs. Big pointed ears, a narrow pointed snout, a long bushy tail, light quick stance.
models.texture_prompt: White and silver arctic fur, pale grey shading, small dark nose, pale blue glowing eyes.

models.name: Salt Jackal
models.library_query: low poly jackal desert dog stylized
models.prompt: Lean scavenger jackal on four long thin legs. Narrow snout, tall pointed ears, a thin tail, ribs slightly showing, wary hunched stance.
models.texture_prompt: Bleached tan and bone-pale fur, dusty shading, amber glowing eyes.

models.name: Dire Boar / The Old Sounder
models.prompt: Bulky wild boar, low-slung on short legs. Humped bristly shoulders, a stiff mane of bristles down the neck, a blunt snout with two upturned ivory tusks, a small curly tail.
models.texture_prompt: Dark brown and black bristle fur, ivory tusks, pink-grey snout, amber glowing eyes.

models.name: Stag Spirit
models.prompt: Graceful deer stag standing tall on slim legs. Modest branching antlers, a slender neck, a short thin tail, gentle poised posture.
models.texture_prompt: Soft warm brown coat, paler underside, bone antlers, pale-blue spectral glowing eyes.
models.notes: Ghostly spirit tint applied per-instance by the game; keep the base natural.

models.name: Jaguar Shade
models.library_query: low poly black panther jaguar stylized
models.prompt: Sleek muscular big cat in a low prowling stance on four legs. Rounded feline head, small ears, a long thin tail held low, shoulders rolling forward.
models.texture_prompt: Near-black charcoal coat with a faint green sheen, green glowing eyes.

models.name: Carrion Crow / Poison Bird / Stymphalian Bird
models.prompt: Menacing corvid raptor bird with broad wings spread mid-flap. Sharp pointed beak, a fanned tail, small glowing eyes, talons tucked.
models.texture_prompt: Glossy black feathers with dark blue sheen, grey beak, small red glowing eyes.

variants.poison: Toxic green and black feathers, acid-green glowing eyes.

models.name: Bone Vulture
models.prompt: Hunched carrion vulture with ragged broad wings held half-open. Bald wrinkled neck and head, a hooked beak, a ruff of feathers at the shoulders, beady glowing eyes.
models.texture_prompt: Dusty brown ragged feathers, pale pink bald head and neck, bone-yellow hooked beak, beady amber eyes.

models.name: Thorn Monkey
models.prompt: Small quick monkey in an agile crouch. Long arms reaching forward, a big round head with a wide face, a curled tail, glowing eyes.
models.texture_prompt: Dark jungle-brown fur, paler face and chest, green glowing eyes.

models.name: Berg Crab
models.prompt: Wide armored crab. A domed faceted shell, three jointed walking legs per side, two big raised pincer claws in front, and two small stalk eyes on top.
models.texture_prompt: Cold blue-grey shell with an icy sheen, frost-white claw tips, pale glowing stalk eyes.

models.name: Dust / Bloom / Reef / Deep Serpent
models.library_query: low poly sea serpent snake stylized
models.prompt: Sea snake rearing its head up from coiled loops. A fanged head with an open jaw, small side fins behind the head, a long scaled body coiling behind in shrinking loops, tapering tail.
models.texture_prompt: Teal scales with a paler belly, darker banding, small side fins, amber glowing eyes.

variants.dust: Dusty tan desert scales, bone-pale belly, amber glowing eyes.
variants.bloom: Leaf-green scales with tiny pink blossoms along the back, green glowing eyes.

models.notes: Serpent rig (tail0..tailN) degrades to body sway; bake the reared pose.
